gaps: The available vocabulary does not expose savings values or every figure for comparison before and after close, and assertion values cannot reference the pre-close read-back. The setup provides a roughly two-minute window rather than an exac

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
Wait until the round has closed (bid end and extra closing time over).
The buyer reads the pricing round.
The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 1.
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 1; Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
